div.head: Ine 73
div.ab: CXVII. Gif hit biþ nyht eald þyfð, gebeten þa ðone gylt þe hine gefengon, swa hy geþingian magon wiþ cyning ⁊ his gerefan.
CXVII. Gif hit bið niht eald þiefð, gebeten þa þone gylt þe hine gefengon, swa hie geþingian mægen wið cyning ⁊ his gerefan.
Si uero sit una nocte uetus furtum, emendent illi culpam, qui ceperunt eum, sicut inde componere poterunt apud regem et prepositum suum.
{CXVII} Gif hit bið niht eald þiefð, gebeten þa þone gylt þe hine gefengon swa hie geþingian mægan wið cyning ⁊ his gerefan.
If the theft is a night old, then let those who caught him [and allowed him to escape] pay whatever debt [for their carelessness] that they may arrange with the king and his reeve.

If a night has elapsed since the thefts, those who caught him [and allowed him to escape] shall make compensation for their offence, according to such terms as they can arrange with the king and his reeve.

Wenn es [das Verbrechen des Entflohenen] ein [schon] eine Nacht alter Diebstahl ist, dann sollen die, die ihn [handhaft] gefasst hatten, diese Schuld [der Unachtsamkeit] büssen, wie sie gegenüber dem König und seinem Amtmann ausmachen können.
If it [the escaped man’s crime] is a theft [already] a night old, then let those who had caught him [red-handed] pay for this fault [of carelessness] as they can settle with the king and his reeve.
